Chapter 1050: 8 Renowned (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2

Chapter 1050: Chapter 8 Renowned (Seeking Monthly Tickets)_2

Moreover, the awakening speed of the Fierce Sun Divine Body is terrifyingly fast, completely unreasonable compared to ordinary beings.

And the ultimately awakened Fierce Sun Divine Body is far stronger than those awakened through normal methods.

Beyond this, beings with a dense Fierce Sun Bloodline possess extreme combat prowess, invincible among their peers? Even fighting across ranks? Both are possible.

“Could it be that my disciple’s bloodline has undergone an ancestral regression? Turning his Fierce Sun Bloodline incomparably dense?”

Lord Qingfen pondered in his heart.

This reasoning also explains why Lin Yuan could condense so many Seeds of the Fierce Sun. For a being with an exceptionally dense Fierce Sun Bloodline, condensing the Seeds of the Fierce Sun is much easier.

As for why he couldn’t detect the life weight of a Great Lord level existence? Because Lin Yuan isn’t a Great Lord at all, but rather a Sovereign Realm being with an extraordinarily dense Fierce Sun Bloodline.

“But to display combat strength nearing that of a Great Lord while being in the Sovereign Realm… my disciple’s Fierce Sun Bloodline density should be on par with the core royal lineage of the Ancient Country.”

Lord Qingfen thought secretly.

The concept of fighting across ranks also depends on the realm one is in.

To battle a Sovereign is still conceivable, but for a Sovereign to battle a Great Lord? It’s akin to climbing the heavens.

Even among the Fierce Sun royal lineage, those capable of achieving such feats are exceedingly rare.

“I never expected that I, Qingfen, would accept a disciple whose Fierce Sun Bloodline rivals the core royal lineage?”

Lord Qingfen grew deeply emotional.

Compared to a Great Lord, the core royal lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is far more significant.

Each member of the core royal lineage possesses an exceptionally dense Fierce Sun Bloodline, their combat prowess terrifyingly high, with almost no bottlenecks in their growth.

Even without cultivating—simply eating and drinking all day under the radiance of the Fierce Sun—they can swiftly grow to the Sovereign Realm. As for reaching the Great Lord Realm? It requires some effort, but with a bit of diligence, it’s achievable.

It must be noted, Lord Qingfen spent countless resources and effort to step into the Great Lord Realm, but the Ancient Country’s core royal lineage?

Of course, those among the core royal lineage with dense Fierce Sun Bloodlines possess outrageous talent and aptitude, but their upper limit is merely the Great Lord Realm. As for the Heavenly Venerate Realm?

Achieving Heavenly Venerate status cannot be reached through bloodline alone.

Still, a core royal lineage member of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, even if only at the Great Lord Realm, commands such terrifying combat strength that they can achieve invincibility among Great Lords and even… challenge Heavenly Venerates.

“My luck…”

Lord Qingfen’s thoughts were complex. He had picked up a disciple who is destined to be invincible at the Great Lord level. To this day, Lord Qingfen almost feels as though he is dreaming.

…

Outside the Sky Burning Court.

Lin Yuan struck down Marquis Purple Dream’s avatar with a single palm and saw Feng Wanxing, who had just arrived.

“Senior Feng.”

Lin Yuan took the initiative to greet him. During his time cultivating in the Sky Burning Court, Lin Yuan had gotten along well with this senior brother.

“Junior?!” Feng Wanxing only dared to respond after hearing Lin Yuan address him as senior. The scene he had just witnessed was so frightening.

Marquis Purple Dream, a figure of such prominence, had been shattered by Lin Yuan with such ease?

Feng Wanxing speculated that Marquis Purple Dream had likely only sent an avatar; her true body probably dared not enter Qingfen City.

But even if it was only an avatar, it was still an avatar of a Great Lord. How could it be easily destroyed?

“Junior, just now?” Feng Wanxing cautiously asked, testing Lin Yuan: “Just now…”

“Oh, just now…” Lin Yuan casually explained, “Some Sovereigns from the Purple Dream Domain snuck into Qingfen City, trying to make a move against me. The commotion in the city just now was caused by them, so I took the initiative to resolve it.”

“Sovereigns from the Purple Dream Domain?”

Feng Wanxing glanced around. While he didn’t know which Sovereigns the Purple Dream Domain had dispatched, anyone bold enough to infiltrate right now would at least be at the peak of the Sovereign Realm.

“Eventually, Marquis Purple Dream sent down an avatar and even tried to threaten me with demands. But an avatar daring to act so boldly? Naturally, I dealt with her too.”

Lin Yuan stated.

“Marquis Purple Dream?”

“Acting so boldly?”

Feng Wanxing suddenly felt that his junior brother seemed unfamiliar now.

He could never have imagined that his usually quiet and reserved junior brother possessed this level of strength.

“Junior, your power?”

Feng Wanxing swallowed hard.

“I’ve just had a breakthrough,” Lin Yuan admitted frankly.

After his Fierce Sun Divine Body awakened, the cultivation resources Lin Yuan needed subsequently were immeasurable, like mountains and oceans. Keeping his strength hidden would, without doubt, be impossible given his demand for resources.

So, rather than concealing it, he opted to display it boldly.

Based on Lin Yuan’s understanding of this source world over his extended stay, a Great Lord-level existence generally has free reign within a region.

As long as one doesn’t offend the royal lineage of the various Ancient Countries, life can be quite carefree.

Lin Yuan’s overall strength now essentially reached the threshold of the Great Lord Realm, and in certain aspects, even surpassed ordinary Great Lords.

Feng Wanxing was full of questions but didn’t know where to begin.

Just had a breakthrough? And already capable of effortlessly destroying the avatar of a Great Lord?

At this moment.

A figure in a crimson long robe appeared not far away.

“Marquis.”

Upon seeing this, Feng Wanxing immediately bowed in greeting.

“You may leave now.”

Lord Qingfen glanced at Feng Wanxing.

From the time-lapse projection, he had seen his eldest disciple’s concern for the younger one.

Thus, he refrained from pursuing the matter of Feng Wanxing leaving the core of the formation without permission.

“Master.”

Lin Yuan addressed Lord Qingfen respectfully.

Lin Yuan held great reverence for Lord Qingfen.

If he hadn’t been able to focus his energy on cultivating in the Sky Burning Court…

Lin Yuan’s path to achieving his current strength would have taken several fold longer.

Not to mention the possibility of encountering unexpected setbacks along the way.
